targetText: The whole truth! If you're my friend and comrade, you'll come.
explanation: Volodya appeals to emotional guilt while hiding his bourgeois infidelity, highlighting the manipulativeness of proprietary marriage.

targetText: Why do you stab me from behind. You know I love only you. Everything else everyone says about me is nonsense
explanation: Volodya gaslights Vassilissa to cover his extramarital affair with Nina, relying on bourgeois possessive dominance.
